review_scope: 10 synthetic feature inputs, independent hand calculations, baseline metrics, explicit generic geometry grid, and separate 3.1.0 drift report. This is a limited initial reference set, not M0-M5 completion.

reference_source.geometry: SimpleITK2.4.1, explicit RAS/LPS conversion; generic outer-edge grid, not PyRadiomics ROI grid

ngtdm_difference_sums.reason: Floating neighborhood means; counts remain exact integers.

linear_logistic_predictions.additional: objective, gradient/KKT, and convergence must also pass

nonfinite.comparison: identical NaN/Inf/-Inf locations and status; JSON encodes these as strings

matrix_comparison.glcm: Exact symmetric integer counts per direction; arrays store gray_i,gray_j,angle. Preserve true gray-level labels.
matrix_comparison.glrlm: Exact integer counts per direction; gray,run_length,angle. Empty-angle behavior follows 3.0.1 C source.
matrix_comparison.gldm_glszm: Exact integer counts with original gray/size labels. Trailing all-zero size columns may be removed explicitly, never renumber populated labels.
matrix_comparison.ngtdm: Columns n_i,s_i,i; n_i and i exact, s_i scalar tolerance. 3.0.1 includes isolated centers with s_i=0.
matrix_comparison.aggregation: Default per-direction features averaged; explicit no_weighting sums matrices first. Both references are separate.

failure_contract.empty_roi: Reference feature classes error; native extraction must error and retain sample failure record.
failure_contract.singleton: Direct class calculation frozen: GLCM/GLRLM return NaN; finite feature results retained for other families. This does not assert the full PyRadiomics extractor accepts its default minimum ROI dimensions.
failure_contract.unknown_profile_or_unsupported_configura: Explicit error; never silently substitute a Python backend or alternative algorithm.
failure_contract.unrepresentable_discretization: Reference errors or nonpositive gray labels at huge magnitude are recorded verbatim in binning_edges.json; native returns explicit InvalidInput/Unsupported because zero is reserved for outside ROI. Other cases require exact labels.

input_license: Original synthetic fixtures dedicated to CC0-1.0; source implementations retain their own licenses.
pending_acceptance: IBSI digital phantom acquisition with explicit redistribution permission and independent IBSI feature comparison
Public CT/ROI licensed fixture and feature reference
Pinned three-task model datasets, objective/KKT references and five-seed 200-tree behavioral reference
Pathology pixel/mask/embedding fixtures and independent specifications
Native CLI/Python workflow leakage, serialization and installation checks
Seven-repeat alternating end-to-end performance and memory gates
update_policy: Generate candidates only into a fresh directory. Main agent reviews source, settings and numerical/exception differences before accepting. Module authors must not re-record expected values.
